title: EIGHT QUARTERS
subtitle: THE WEIGHT OF THE PLATFORM - banking pack

mandates.text: AGENTS ON OUR DATA - DEMO BY Q4
BRING TREASURY IN FROM THE COLD

quirks.text: The warehouse runs on hardware the vendor stopped supporting.
Marketing's ungoverned env is load-bearing at quarter-end.
The half-finished migration has a named enemy in Infrastructure.
Treasury's laptop pipeline was built by the CFO's protege.
Retail is mid-reorg - locked for two quarters.
Audit still holds the Q1 masking finding over you.

options.label: CENTRALIZE - one platform team owns everything
FEDERATE - BUs build, platform owns the seams

forks.title: GOVERN IN THE PLATFORM, OR AROUND IT?

options.label: IN THE PLATFORM - controls run automatically
GOVERN AROUND IT - process, review, flexibility

forks.title: STANDARDIZE INGESTION, OR LET BUS CHOOSE?

options.label: STANDARDIZE - one pattern per source type
LET BUS CHOOSE - speed over uniformity
FOUNDATION FIRST - the argument you have been making
AI FIRST - demo now, foundation later

debts.question: When two BUs join their data, whose sign-off promotes the result?
When an agent is confidently wrong in a meeting, who fields it?
By what process does a table in our estate stop existing?

events.title: AUDIT FINDING: MASKING MISMATCH
events.text: The regulator's paper asks why two BUs mask the same column differently. Your Q2 fork seeded this.
events.seed_label: seeded by Q2: govern around it

responses.label: Publish the correction, fund the fix

events.title: SHADOW ANALYTICS GOES PRODUCTION-CRITICAL
events.text: Marketing's ungoverned env now runs quarter-end. Nobody planned this. Nobody owns it.

events.title: 02:14 FRIDAY - THE REGULATORY NUMBER MOVED
events.text: A source system changed a schema on a Friday. The gold table feeding the quarterly report moved with it.
events.seed_label: the estate you inherited - unless ownership was answered

responses.label: Page the named owner - Priya N. has it
Improvise - pull three teams in at 2am

events.title: THE CFO ASKS WHY DATA COSTS WHAT IT COSTS
events.text: Josephine Lim's meeting. One number on the screen, no names attached to it. The room is waiting for yours.
events.seed_label: the day-one decision you deferred or made

responses.label: Show the attribution - your number has names on it

events.title: INTERNAL AUDIT REQUESTS FULL-POPULATION EVIDENCE
events.text: Remi Okafor's office wants to test every transaction. It is a query now - if your platform can answer it.
events.seed_label: the audit posture your governance track bought or skipped

responses.label: Deliver a sample and a plan

events.title: THE BOARD CUT THE PLATFORM TEAM IN HALF
events.text: Nobody asks this in the good years. Controls that live in automation survive headcount. Controls that live in people's weeks do not.
events.seed_label: the operating model you chose in Q1

responses.label: Protect the templates - the paved road survives

events.title: THE CEO WANTS THE AGENT PILOT STARTED NOW
events.text: Rico Sandoval's office again. The word 'demonstrable' appears twice.
events.seed_label: the mandate you drew on day one

responses.label: Start the pilot - read-only, for now

events.title: THE AGENT WAS CONFIDENTLY WRONG IN THE MEETING
events.text: It misquoted churn numbers to the CMO's staff. Confidently. With a chart.
events.seed_label: seeded by the pilot you started before the gates

responses.label: Contain it - inspect the receipt, fix the source

events.title: AGUILAR OFFERED LENDING A MANAGED ALTERNATIVE
events.text: Real vendor quotes. Cheap. His instance promises 'one throat to choke'. Lending is listening.
events.seed_label: the rival you chose to fight or feed

responses.label: Let them look - confidence is a strategy

events.title: AGUILAR'S 'MANAGED INSTANCE' GOES LIVE
events.text: His email to the exec team is one paragraph and every line is true. Consolidation, cost, control.
events.seed_label: the rival storyline - he is not wrong, that is the problem

responses.label: Demo offence - show what the paved road ships

events.title: RETAIL SHIPPED ON A VENDOR WITH A CREDIT CARD
events.text: Sofia Cruz's team needed a two-day answer. The ticket queue said two weeks. The vendor said one.
events.seed_label: the paved road you paved - or did not

responses.label: Embrace it - adopt what Retail built
Crack down - enforce the front door

events.title: TREASURY'S LAPTOP PIPELINE DIED AT QUARTER-END
events.text: The nightly reconciliation ran on a laptop. It chose the worst possible night to stop.
events.seed_label: a quirk you drew on day one

meetings.give: Identity L2 computed access by Q4, funded from her incident budget
meetings.get: CISO backing for the agent pilot + early warning on SOC findings

meetings.give: Showback first - every team sees its number before the board does
meetings.get: A one-time budget uplift of $250k and her vote against chargeback

meetings.give: Lineage from the regulatory report to source by Q5
meetings.get: Risk acceptance for your pilots - the regulator hears it from her first

meetings.give: Templates for her top source type by Q3
meetings.get: Retail adopts - and brings its decision volume with it

meetings.give: A promise: at the halving, the team's work is protected
meetings.get: His once-per-game unprompted vouch, banked now

meetings.give: A demo-prep plan he can show the board next quarter
meetings.get: He buys you one quarter of runway on the agent clock

promise.text: Agent L1 by the clock minus one

foreshadow: The CFO has scheduled a cost review. Attribution decides whether it is a review or an argument.
The CEO said the word 'agents' twice in one meeting. The clock is becoming a promise.
Audit has not forgotten the masking finding. It will reappear in a quarter you do not choose.
Aguilar's vendor quotes are real. Lending's CIO took the meeting.
Retail's next sprint plan has a line item that is not your platform.
